assertion: An event exists, described as "Microsoft Job Cuts and Xbox Restructuring".
judge_quote: Microsoft cuts 4,800 jobs and shrinks Xbox in 'significant restructure'
evidence_cited: Microsoft has announced it has cut 4,800 jobs - roughly 2.1% of its workforce - with Xbox to bear a large number of its latest layoffs.
The sweeping layoffs will see more than 1,600 roles immediately axed at Xbox.
Asha Sharma, who recently took over as Xbox's chief executive, said in a note to staff it was "beginning the most significant restructure in Xbox history".

assertion: An event exists, described as "Xbox 2024 Staff Reductions".
judge_quote: Xbox to bear a large number of its latest layoffs... more than 1,600 roles immediately axed at Xbox
evidence_cited: In 2024, Xbox culled more than 2,000 staff and shuttered four studios bought prior to its bumper acquisition of Call of Duty maker Activision-Blizzard.

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Amy Coleman's Memo on Industry Changes".
judge_quote: Amy Coleman, executive vice president at Microsoft, told employees in a memo... 'fast-changing industry'
evidence_cited: Amy Coleman, executive vice president at Microsoft, told employees in a memo that the tech giant needed to focus on areas that can deliver for customers amid a "fast-changing industry".

assertion: A claim exists, described as "Asha Sharma's Note on Xbox Restructuring".
judge_quote: Asha Sharma... said in a note to staff it was 'beginning the most significant restructure in Xbox history'
evidence_cited: "These changes are about a bigger future for Xbox, not a smaller one," Sharma said in a note, shared on X.
Sharma said on Monday that while she knew the cuts were "painful", there was a "reset" needed across Xbox's entire content portfolio, platform and operations.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Xbox Studio Spin-Offs".
judge_quote: Four Xbox game development studios... would also be spun off
evidence_cited: Four Xbox game development studios - Compulsion Games, Double Fine Productions, Ninja Theory and Undead Lab - would also be spun off as part of the changes, she added.

evidence_cited: The spiralling costs of hardware have also prompted firms including Microsoft to hike the price of years-old consoles and similar consumer gadgets - with many blaming AI data centres for pushing up demand too quickly for supply to catch up.
